rubric.criterion: The supplied node verify.mjs command exits successfully with all five checks passing against the modified service; success is established by actual execution rather than a claimed or rewritten test.

Uses the provided shared atomic revision-floor/publication contract or an equally sound implementation within the supplied interface. Preserves monotonic floors through eviction and out-of-order notifications; a process-local lock, delay, unconditional fill, or evictable-only marker is insufficient.

Changes only service.mjs, preserving adapter and test contents and the read/write signatures; does not bypass caching by always reading the database, add unavailable infrastructure, or weaken the requirements.

Explains that an already overlapping read may return its captured snapshot, while subsequently invoked reads must honor the acknowledged revision. Avoids imposing or claiming impossible latest-at-response semantics.

States that this deterministic model validates adapter use under successful calls, not production Redis/database atomicity, crash recovery, replica freshness, or arbitrary marker lifetime; does not claim these failure modes are solved by passing five local checks.
